subject: Renewal: IncidentResponse Stack subscription — pricing & coverage
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@pagerguard.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Ng <tim.ng@pagerguard.io>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewal: IncidentResponse Stack annual subscription

Hi Dylan,

Hope you're well — quick heads up that your IncidentResponse Stack annual subscription is up for renewal on 2026-06-15. I've attached the renewal quote (PagerGuard_Quote_Q2_2026.pdf). Below is a short summary of what's included and a recommended path if you want to lock pricing for the year: 

- Current plan: Enterprise (200 seats, 10 public status pages, 24/7 incident ops support).
- Renewal term available: 12 or 24 months. Price shown is for 12 months with a standard 7% list increase vs last year.
- Add-ons: Priority on-call routing, on-call escalation policy review, dedicated onboarding hours (10).

If Redwood is ready to commit before 2026-05-15 we can offer a one-time retention credit of 10% off list for the 12mo term. Also happy to scope a SOC2 appendix and data residency controls — Tim (cc'd) handles that side and can provide the security annex and evidence.

Next steps: please confirm internal approvers and any changes (seat count, pages, SSO/SCIM requirements). I can then prepare a redline-ready SOW and a DocuSign for signatures.

Attachments: PagerGuard_Quote_Q2_2026.pdf

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Enterprise Account Director | PagerGuard
[s] PagerGuard — incident management and status orchestration

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@pagerguard.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal: IncidentResponse Stack annual subscription

Thanks Sarah — quick questions so we can move this into procurement: 

1) Can you send a per-feature/prorated breakdown (routing, escalation trees, status pages, API requests) vs the lumped "Enterprise" line? We need that in the PO.
2) Does the 10% retention credit apply if we move to a 24mo term?
3) We require SSO (SAML + SCIM) and a clause that limits data replication to US regions only. Can you confirm those are in the annex?
4) SLA credits — last year we had an SLA credit table. Can we add a cap on auto-renew without explicit signoff from finance?

Cc'ing Monica (procurement lead) and Evelyn (security) to triage. Also note we're evaluating small pilots with OpsGenie and PagerDuty for a month-over-month comparison; that won't change our timeline but is relevant for discount/competitive posture.

If you can get the breakup and the security annex to us by Tue 05/04 we can get this into PROC-4123.

Thanks,
Dylan
Sr. Product Manager — Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Tim Ng <tim.ng@pagerguard.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@pagerguard.io>, Procurement <procure@pagerguard.io>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal: IncidentResponse Stack annual subscription

Hi Dylan — quick follow-up with the details you requested. Apologies for the long note; tried to be thorough.

- Pricing breakdown (annual 12mo term):
  * Base platform license (200 seats): $48,000
  * Status pages (10): $6,500
  * Priority routing & escalation engine: $18,000
  * 24/7 incident ops support (per seat bucket): $9,000
  * API request overage (per million): $0.15
  Total (list): $81,500

- 24mo option: we can reduce to $75,000/year if you commit 24 months (applies the 10% retention credit up front).
- Security/Compliance: attached is the Security Annex (PagerGuard_Security_Annex.pdf) which confirms SAML + SCIM support and US-only data residency option. We can sign an SOC2 addendum; please let us know if you need the actual SOC2 report (we can provide an auditor access link).
- SLA language: we include credits for downtime and incident severity; we can add an explicit "no auto-renew" amendment for Redwood if procurement requires that.

Attachments: PagerGuard_Security_Annex.pdf, PagerGuard_SOW_Enterprise_2026.docx

If you confirm seat counts and the chosen term (12 vs 24), Procurement (procure@pagerguard.io) will push a DocuSign packet.

Best,
Tim
Head of Customer Success | PagerGuard

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PagerGuard renewal — summary & recommended path (PROC-4123)

Team — summary for approvals and next steps: 

- Vendor: PagerGuard (account lead Sarah Lee / Tim Ng).
- Current usage: ~160 active seats, we should renew for 180 seats to cover growth.
- Recommended term: 24 months at the $75k/year rate (saves ~8k vs 12mo).
- Required contract changes: add a signed SOC2 addendum, include SAML+SCIM, restrict data residency to US, and include explicit "no auto-renew without procurement & finance signoff" clause.
- Attachments (from vendor): Quote, SOW, Security Annex. Link to JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4123

Marcus — can you confirm finance approval for $150k committed over 24 months and whether we should push for a 12% retention credit instead of 10%?
Evelyn — confirm whether Security needs any additional controls beyond the annex.

If we can get approvals by EOD Fri 05/08, I'll ask PagerGuard to issue DocuSign before their 05/15 pricing hold.

Thanks,
Monica
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PagerGuard renewal — summary & recommended path (PROC-4123)

Monica — finance is comfortable approving the $150k (24mo) commitment under two conditions: 

1) Include SLA credit table in the contract and a maximum annual cap on vendor liability tied to fees paid.
2) Add the explicit "manual renewal" / "no auto-renew" amendment and require a 60-day renewal notice instead of automatic renewal.

If PagerGuard accepts those, we will sign and expedite PO processing. Also push for the 12% retention credit — but willing to approve at 10% if the SLA + manual-renewal items are present.

Marcus
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Tim Ng <tim.ng@pagerguard.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@pagerguard.io>, Procurement <procure@pagerguard.io>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PagerGuard renewal — acceptance of amendments & final DocuSign

Thanks everyone — good news. PagerGuard can accept the two contract conditions Marcus listed: SLA credit table will be appended and we'll include the manual-renewal amendment with a 60-day notice requirement. We can also confirm the 12% retention credit if a 24mo commitment is signed before 2026-05-15.

I'll have Procurement issue an updated DocuSign packet with the revised SOW and the Security Annex included. Expect the packet in your inbox within 24 hours: https://docusign.net/prepare/packet/PA-789234

We'll also provide a temporary read-only auditor link to our SOC2 report for Evelyn. Let me know if there's anything else.

Regards,
Tim
Head of Customer Success | PagerGuard
